exposure: minimal or no antibiotics in term babies born after prolonged rupture of membranes
cohort: Asymptomatic, term neonates born to women with prolonged rupture of membranes (>12 hours prior to birth) in Papua New Guinea.
finding: The protocol for minimal or no antibiotics resulted in a 7.5% rate of sepsis signs in the first week and 3% between 8-28 days among assessed newborns, with one case of bacteraemia and no deaths, a rate comparable to other studies in low-income countries.
